title: anguria bignoniacea var. pallida
intro: Anguria bignoniacea var. pallida, commonly known as White Chalice Vine, is a species of flowering plant in the Bignoniaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Anguria bignoniacea var. pallida include anti-edematous, antispasmodic, and sedative effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as anxiety and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
